English: A check of what has been accepted without proof.
English: To make a meaning clearer.
English: To give the main points briefly.

words.es: My summary separates evidence from unresolved questions.
words.en: Mi resumen separa la evidencia de las preguntas sin resolver.

words.es: I will summarize the main points.

lesson.speaking: The student combines a glossary explanation, a briefing, and a written summary. Explain the distinction between synthesis and evidence. Ask your partner for clarification, then summarize their answer.

examples.es: If the time changes, I will confirm it.
examples.en: Si cambia la hora, la confirmaré.

examples.es: Unless the time changes, we will use this schedule.
examples.en: A menos que cambie la hora, usaremos este horario.
